ESCALATION FIX (research-agent.yml) — exact human patch: in EACH `with:` block of the three anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 steps (standard Opus, deep-tier Fable, deep-tier Opus fallback), add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` alongside `claude_code_oauth_token:`. This allow-lists only the repo's own github-actions bot (the sole bot that dispatches escalations, scripts/escalate-research.js) WITHOUT using `*` (the action's own action.yml warns `*` on a public repo could let external GitHub Apps invoke the action with attacker-controlled prompts). The action's actor matcher lowercases both sides and strips a trailing '[bot]' (src/github/validation/actor.ts isAllowedBot), so the bare login `github-actions` matches the github-actions[bot] actor. Restores the scout/coverage-critic -> deep research fast lane, dead for months. Documented with this exact patch in OPEN issue #430.

VISUAL-QA FIX (visual-qa-agent.yml) — exact human patch: raise `--max-turns 40` -> `--max-turns 80` in the claude_args of the single anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step (matching verify/ui-fix/self-repair, which already use 80; a clean visual-qa pass finishes around 47 turns, so 80 gives comfortable headroom). Failures reach the cap in ~4 min, well under the job's 15-min timeout, so the raise does not risk the timeout. Could alternatively be tightened from the NON-protected scripts/agents/visual-qa.md prompt side (improve agent's domain), but 40 is simply too tight for the task and the direct fix is the max-turns bump.
